children: Copper falls in early Asian trade. Sentiment is being weighed by weakness in technology stocks and softer Chinese economic data recently, ING commodities strategists say in a note. The sell-off in artificial intelligence-related shares is raising concerns around the outlook for copper demand, given the metal's growing exposure to investment in power grids and data centers, they add. Weaker Chinese industrial production data for October also added to concerns about demand from the world's largest copper consumer, they say. The three-month LME copper contract is 0.4% lower at $13,171.00 a ton.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
